summary: Frontend-only testing completed for gym tracker app. Found 4 critical bugs affecting core functionality: language toggle not working, library filtering/search not working, exercise detail modal not opening, and tab navigation requires clicking tab buttons (not text labels). Bottom navigation, basic UI rendering, and screen layouts are working correctly.

react_native_issues.issue: Language toggle button clicks but text does not change from English to Hungarian. Button visual state changes (HU button highlights) but translations do not apply. Zustand language store may not be triggering re-renders.

Type filter buttons (All/Calisthenics/Gym) are clickable but do not filter exercises. Exercise count remains at 93 regardless of filter selection. Both GYM and BW badges still visible after selecting Calisthenics filter.
Muscle group filter chips (All, Chest, Back, Shoulders, Legs, etc.) are clickable but do not filter exercises. Exercise count remains at 93 regardless of selection.
Search input accepts text but does not filter exercises. Searching for 'push', 'squat', or 'pull' shows no change in results. Exercise count remains at 93.
Clicking on exercises does not open the detail modal. Modal does not appear in DOM. Description, Instructions, and Tips sections are not displayed.

Tab navigation works when clicking tab buttons ([role='tab']) but NOT when clicking text labels. Using 'text=Workout' selector does not navigate, but clicking the tab button does. This is a minor UX issue but affects testability.

action_items: Fix language toggle: Investigate why Zustand languageStore state changes don't trigger component re-renders. Check if persist middleware is interfering with reactivity.

Fix library filtering: All three filter types (type, muscle group, search) are broken. The filteredExercises logic in library.tsx looks correct, but state updates are not causing re-renders. Likely React state management issue.
Fix exercise detail modal: Modal is not opening when exercises are clicked. Check if setSelectedExercise state update is working and if Modal component is properly configured.

Investigate React Native web state update issues: Multiple components show state update failures (language, filters, modal). This suggests a systemic issue with state management or React Native web rendering.
Consider adding console.log statements to verify state changes are actually occurring in the stores.

library.tsx lines 129-178: Exercise rendering uses filteredExercises and groupedExercises correctly, but UI shows all 93 exercises regardless of filters.

context_for_next_testing_agent: This is a React Native/Expo app using Zustand for state management with AsyncStorage persistence. The app renders correctly and basic navigation works, but there are critical state management issues preventing filters, search, language toggle, and modals from working. The root cause appears to be that state updates are not triggering component re-renders. Check if there's a React Native web compatibility issue with Zustand or if components need to be wrapped with observers/subscribers. The 'Cannot use import.meta outside a module' console error may be related.
rca_of_issue: Root Cause Analysis: Multiple state-dependent features are failing (language toggle, filters, search, modal opening). All these features update local component state or Zustand store state, but the UI does not reflect these changes. This suggests one of the following: 1) React Native web may have issues with state reactivity, 2) Zustand store updates are not triggering re-renders (possibly due to persist middleware), 3) Components are not properly subscribed to store changes, or 4) There's a bundling/compilation issue (evidenced by 'import.meta' error) preventing proper React reactivity. The fact that initial render works but state updates don't propagate points to a reactivity/subscription issue rather than a logic error.
